acceptedAnswer.text: A split screen: the fields the parser read on one side, your real document on the other — the genuine PDF rendered in place, or the Excel sheet drawn inline. You verify each read against the page it came from, in seconds.

mainEntity.name: Is it the real document or a re-render?

acceptedAnswer.text: The real document. A PDF opens as the genuine PDF, page and all, with its own zoom and fit-to-width; an Excel WPS renders as the actual sheet. You're checking against the file your welding engineer signed, not the app's interpretation of it.

mainEntity.name: Can I fix a misread while I'm looking at it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Edit the value or its label right inside Preview, tick a low-confidence field as verified, or accept a computed heat input — all without leaving the view. Compare and fix are the same screen.

mainEntity.name: Does a correction update the rest of the app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A fix in Preview updates the library detail, the register column titles and the review badge together, so one correction is reflected everywhere it should be — no re-entering it elsewhere.

mainEntity.name: Will it stay open while I work through a form?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Preview is a verification workspace, not a modal that closes on a stray click. It stays put while you work a document field by field, and you can widen the source pane up to half the screen for a dense form.

mainEntity.name: How does it handle a heat input the app calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: A computed heat input is flagged for verification like any low-confidence read. Accept it in Preview and its verify clears the amber across every pass at once, so a single confirmation settles the whole calculation.
